title: The Thundering Coast
dek: Prima’s Thundering Coast, seen from the approach to Eovar Harbor and crossed toward a distant beacon.
sources: Quest narrator · harbor/coast approach, posted 13 March 2024 · https://discord.com/channels/1177270231513694249/1199083630354501673/1217654903535702158
Quest narrator · beacon beyond the coast, posted 27 May 2024 · https://discord.com/channels/1177270231513694249/1199083630354501673/1244736241862311958
body:
The Thundering Coast belongs to Prima. It appears in the adventurers’ approach to Eovar Harbor and in the preparations for a voyage toward a light beyond the coast.

13 March 2024 · the harbor comes into view

After breaking a trap on the road to Eovar, Jiangshi, Scribonia, Rolen, John, Adelia and Forgax reach the final hill overlooking the harbor and the Thundering Coast.

27 May 2024 · passage toward the light

With Eovar’s quarantine lifted, Olokun, Loistava, Nienna, Adelia, Bari and Alyhotep seek passage at the docks toward the beacon shining beyond the Thundering Coast. The harbor reconnects the party to sailors, ships and travel beyond the shore.

The coast’s exact boundaries and the beacon’s precise position remain unconfirmed.
imageAlt: Aerial landscape of the Thundering Coast on Prima
